lines.text: Older than me, not from me!
Many learners say: He is older from me.
Better: He is older than me.
Than! She is younger than me.

native.tip: Türkçede “benden büyük” deriz (“-den”); İngilizcede “from” değil “than” kullanılır.
native.caption: “He is older from me” mi diyorsun? 😅 Türkçedeki “-den” karşılaştırmada “from” olmaz; “than” denir. Doğrusu “He is older than me.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “than”. Karşılaştırırken “than” de. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: The Turkish “-den” is “than” here: “He is older than me.”
en.caption: Do you say “He is older from me”? 😅 To compare we say “than”, not “from”. The right sentence is “He is older than me.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
